title: Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will introduce Writing blocks by mid-September 2026, enabling users to create and refine longer-form content like emails and reports within Copilot. This feature enhances productivity by providing a dedicated editing workspace without leaving Copilot. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.
body:
[What and Why:]

We're introducing Writing blocks in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Writing blocks provide a dedicated editing experience for content such as emails, memos, announcements, reports, and other drafts directly within Copilot.

With Writing blocks, users can create, review, and iteratively refine longer-form content in a structured workspace without leaving the Copilot experience, helping improve productivity and streamline content creation workflows.

[Rollout Schedule:]

- General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-September 2026 and expect to complete by late September 2026.[Impact on Your Organization:]

Who is affected:

- Users with access to Microsoft 365 Copilot.Platforms/Services:

- Microsoft 365 Copilot.What will happen:

- Users will be able to create and edit content in dedicated Writing blocks within Copilot.- Writing blocks will support drafting and revising content such as emails, memos, announcements, reports, and other business documents.- Users can iteratively refine content directly in Copilot without repeatedly generating new responses.- This is a user-facing enhancement designed to make content creation and editing more efficient.[Action Required / Recommendations:]

No action is required.

We recommend informing your users about this new capability and updating any internal adoption or training materials that describe content creation workflows in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
bodyHtml:
[What and Why:]

We're introducing Writing blocks in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Writing blocks provide a dedicated editing experience for content such as emails, memos, announcements, reports, and other drafts directly within Copilot.

With Writing blocks, users can create, review, and iteratively refine longer-form content in a structured workspace without leaving the Copilot experience, helping improve productivity and streamline content creation workflows.

[Rollout Schedule:]

  • General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-September 2026 and expect to complete by late September 2026.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Who is affected:

  • Users with access to Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Platforms/Services:

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot.

What will happen:

  • Users will be able to create and edit content in dedicated Writing blocks within Copilot.
  • Writing blocks will support drafting and revising content such as emails, memos, announcements, reports, and other business documents.
  • Users can iteratively refine content directly in Copilot without repeatedly generating new responses.
  • This is a user-facing enhancement designed to make content creation and editing more efficient.

[Action Required / Recommendations:]

No action is required.

We recommend informing your users about this new capability and updating any internal adoption or training materials that describe content creation workflows in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
